title: Anaakar Dariyyo
intro: baad fidin bood yaaxigeemik afal, imaan kee ammirtimiyyak addah tan aqayyaare tekke. Ta aydaadi numtin amoh abtoota yamaatu waa horah ceelo taceeh tan abtoota gorrisa. Naba aysinuu kee tet finqah yan xaloot lih yangiicilleh yan roocih aydaadu fidgah gulguluh gaca.
clues: Anu ardi bagul gexe qemmoh xaylok numuk teynak suge, qemmoh addah seehadayti baxi awki.
Yoo kee yi toobokoyta Yallih fida kah naceem amrisenno, ni qadliinoh gibbatu.
yi xayyos moggolinna, yi toobokoytih suge wak, toh yi sorkocobaxi kibbimte bohoy le cusot.
Anu inni toobokoytah bohoy le qangor yaabeh, cinek qeero saniitisak suge.
Yi toobokoyti Yallih qadlii kee Taqwaa yoh kassiisaah, wagsiise kas kee taqwaa.
yi toobokoytih xabcin qangor kee kay qafuuta fayxi lem takkay immay, anu mano beeh, gacte marak numuk teyna akkuk.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
